reviewed_interpretation: Fresh I023 public-development evidence is valid and shipping-mirror exact. The upstream-high/local-low disagreement state covers 5210/8520 low-local false negatives (61.15%), so it is highly relevant to the recall gap, but it is not a safe speech admission state: it occurs on 8337 oracle-speech frames and 9147 oracle-noise frames, giving development-corpus conditional speech precision of only 47.68%. It occupies 30.65% of all oracle-noise frames and 35.36% of oracle-speech frames. On noise disagreement frames, 33.22% are already shipping-active and 36.14% enter with pre-existing hangover, while 98.47% perform no current-frame refresh, 1.53% weak-refresh and 0% strong-refresh. Median shipping probability on noise disagreement is only 0.2479, below the 0.35 decision threshold. Therefore directly trusting upstream-high/local-low disagreement for activation, guard bypass, threshold relaxation or hold refresh is not justified; the current state machine is suppressing a large population of upstream-high noise frames. Any next step must first test whether existing observables can separate disagreement speech from disagreement noise without tuning or candidate selection.

cross_slice_review.reviewed_interpretation: The same safety conclusion persists across all seven noise domains and all -5/0/5/10/15 dB SNR slices. No noise domain reaches even 0.54 development conditional speech precision, while disagreement occupies at least 22.06% of oracle-noise frames in every noise domain. Reverb and anechoic slices likewise remain near chance conditional precision with high noise occupancy. The disagreement state is therefore not a domain-local artifact and cannot be treated as a safe direct admission signal.

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: I023 rejects direct trust of the upstream-high/local-low state because it is common on noise as well as speech. Before abandoning state-only improvement entirely, one final candidate-zero decomposition should test whether already-observed shipping diagnostics (upstream probability margin, local ratio_db, crest_db, raw/pre-blend probability, noise-update state, pre-hangover and short temporal context) robustly separate disagreement speech from disagreement noise across domains. If no stable separation exists, close the state-only VAD route and move root cause upstream rather than tuning guards.

verification_limits: I023 is candidate-zero and uses development-only oracle labels. Its disagreement conditional speech precision is conditional on the constructed public-development sampling distribution and is not a calibrated product-environment positive predictive value.

The post-disagreement active fraction is descriptive occupancy only. Subsequent non-disagreement frames may receive independent evidence or refresh, so this metric cannot be interpreted as causal hangover attributable solely to the preceding disagreement episode.
I023 observes current shipping behavior only; it does not execute a local-guard bypass, upstream-trust activation, threshold relaxation, blend change or hold change.
The artifact contains per-case/per-slice aggregate evidence but no raw frame trace archive or audio.
